evidence.note: Proves concentration theorems giving explicit convergence rates for one-shot magnitude pruning in asymptotic single-neuron settings, introduces the 'conditional perceptron' for early exit with generalization-error bounds tied to a compute-gap parameter, and extends the analysis to deep networks and a neural-network-Gaussian-process framework deriving compute-accuracy tradeoffs for frozen-backbone early-exit systems, validated on vision and language models.
evidence.title: Theoretical Guarantees for One-Shot Magnitude Pruning and Compute-Adaptive Early Exit
